title: The Possible route to the coast
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：possible　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 possible 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the observer wrote of ① a possible route to the coast in the log, and everybody in the observatory said at once that it was ② more possible than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the observer, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the possible ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most possible route to the coast anybody in the observatory had ever seen, or so the log for November 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too possible to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the possible ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a possible answer to the question, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as possible as the answer to the question they had once had in the old observatory. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was possible or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something possible, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next observatory called the whole plan ⑧ quite possible; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the possible ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, with great care, she wrote of another possible route to the coast in the same log, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more possible than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most possible answer to the question in the whole observatory, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the possible ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 可能（前置定语 a possible route to the coast：1985 年观测员在观测记录里记下的那件可能的可行路线）
B. adj. 可能／可行（比较级 more possible than：文中两处，一处比去海边的可行路线，一处比预想）
C. adj. 可能／可行（最高级 the most possible：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 可能（表语 too possible to do：母亲觉得它太可能，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 可行（前置定语 a possible answer to the question：叔叔把整件事称作一桩可行的可能答案）
F. adj. 可行（同级比较 as possible as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩问题的可能答案相比）
G. adj. 可行（后置定语 something possible：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 可行（受程度副词修饰 quite possible：那位助手的评价）

items.q: a possible route to the coast
the most possible route to the coast anybody
a possible answer to the question
The most possible answer to the question in

answers.why: possible 意为“可能”，1985 年观测员在观测记录里记下的是“一件可能的可行路线”，此处作前置定语 a possible route to the coast。
possible 意为“可能”，此处用比较级 more possible than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
possible 意为“可能”，观测记录上 十一月 那行字说它是观测站里最可能的一件，故用最高级 the most possible route to the coast。
possible 意为“可能”，母亲认为这件东西“太可能了，谁也用不上”，too possible to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
possible 意为“可行”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩可行的可能答案”，此处作前置定语 a possible answer to the question。
possible 意为“可行”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩问题的可能答案一样可行”，同级比较用 as possible as。
possible 意为“可行”，观测记录上那半行字要的是“可行的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something possible。
possible 意为“可行”，邻观测站来的那位助手认为这套计划“相当可行”，quite 修饰原级 possible。
possible 意为“可行”，1995 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要可行”，故用比较级 more possible than。
possible 意为“可行”，母亲 1997 年说的是“整个观测站里最可行的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most possible answer to the question。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，观测员在观测记录里记下了一件可能的可行路线。（a possible route to the coast）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更可能。（more possible than …）
母亲觉得它太可能，谁也用不上。（too possible to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩可行的可能答案。（a possible answer to the question）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩问题的可能答案一样可行。（as possible as …）
到了 1992 年，观测记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件可行的东西。（something possible）
answers: In 1985 the observer wrote of a possible route to the coast in the log.
Everybody said it was more possible than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too possible to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a possible answer to the question.
He said nobody would call it as possible as the answer to the question they had once had.
By 1992 the log asked for nothing but something possible.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 possible 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the observer wrote of a possible route to the coast in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most possible route to the coast in the observatory, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too possible to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a possible answer to the question, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next observatory called the plan quite possible, and everybody laughed.
The possible ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
